title: 毎日杯の後に・行雲流水

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (This is it! All of my opponents have fallen behind me!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan
text_block_list.text: You got this, Oguriiiii! Keep going!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I can feel her closing in behind me! What ludicrous speed!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Argh… HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap! It's Oguri Cap! Oguri Cap has taken first!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I fell short…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Oguri's burst of speed during the final stretch was unbelievable…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Yet I never once sensed any form of blistering passion from her during the race.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Her stride was relaxed yet honed… just like pristine, flowing waters.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Her running style is nothing like mine.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I won't let this defeat define me. I'll redeem myself again one day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki doesn't seem particularly dejected over her defeat. When she returns to the waiting room, she's her usual stoic self.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No… I'm embarrassed of my performance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With that said, I'm pleased that I was able to run without overexerting myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was much more stable than I was at my debut, and I successfully controlled the blaze fierce with the waters still.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I may even be able to take the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's confidence is evident. She seems to have gained valuable experience for the upcoming Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, without any delay, we start training for the race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yaeno! What a coincidence. Are you planning to go for a jog too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's my warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Do you usually run around here?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I generally run on the path by the hill…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I suppose I most often run by the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I see. The path by the riverbank is—huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan just got out of a taxi. I wonder where she's coming from…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ardaaan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan! Did you just get back from somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was at the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, I was only there for my regular checkup. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have decided not to enter the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The strain from my debut race has lasted longer than expected…I require more time to recover.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It will be difficult to reach peak condition in time for the Satsuki Sho, so I have decided to take my chances on my ultimate goal instead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I seek glory equal to that of my famed sister, who made history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall take the highest honor a classic-year racer can… I speak of course of the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I plan to use this time to thoroughly prepare myself for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My body may be as fragile as glass, but I have not the slightest intention of losing. I will focus all of my energy on the Derby from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall also be keeping a close eye on how the two of you run at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Of course. Make sure to watch carefully.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I will. Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even if she isn't there, it doesn't change what I must do.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must win the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: D-don't count me out just yet! I'm not gonna let you beat me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Until we meet at the Satsuki Sho, then.
